title: Average restricted Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $J,S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Fix the signs outside $J$ and form the Fourier coefficient of the resulting restricted function at the frequency $S$ when $S\subseteq J$; define the ambient restriction coefficient to be zero when $S\nsubseteq J$. Its uniform average over all choices of the fixed signs equals $\widehat f(S)$ if $S\subseteq J$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinates
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
